'''Yos Kolina''' was the eighty-second [[King of Mon Cala/Legends|King of Mon Cala]], reigning over the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] in support of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A strong and respected leader, he worked with such [[Advisor/Legends|advisors]] as [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Meena Tills/Legends|Meena Tills]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] of the [[Mon Calamari Guard/Legends|Mon Calamari Guard]] to ensure the well-being of his people, in addition to operating with the [[Mon Calamari Council]]. Although the Mon Calamari and their [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] neighbors always clashed over their differences, Kolina was able to keep the peace thanks to [[Gender/Legends|his]] friendship with the Quarren [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]], [[Nossor Ri/Legends|Nossor Ri]], with the two leaders dispelling tensions through open discussion and mutual respect. They remained united in their support of the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and Kolina even led [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] from both peoples into battle during his rule over [[Dac/Legends|Mon Cala]].

In the [[21 BBY/Legends|second year]] of the war, Kolina found the unity of his kingdom challenged when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] began to make advances on the [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Calamari system]]. Kolina petitioned the Republic and the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] for aid, but he was shortly thereafter [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] by Separatist [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]]. Having been integral to his people's peace with the Quarren, Kolina's sudden [[Death/Legends|death]] left the throne to his young son, [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]]. Renouncing Mon Calamari rule, Nossor Ri and the Quarren allied with the Confederacy, resulting in [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|civil war]] on Mon Cala. Nevertheless, Lee-Char was able to bring the fighting to an end with the support of Captain Ackbar and the Republic, succeeding his [[Parent/Legends|father]] as [[King/Legends|King]] of Mon Cala.

==Biography==
===King of Mon Cala===
{{Quote|Generals, I regret to inform you that the situation here is grave. While my people remain loyal to the Republic, the Separatists are making advances on the system, and may soon threaten our home planet.|Yos Kolina, to Plo Koon and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="CWAvg" />}}
The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Yos Kolina was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] into the royal [[Blood/Legends|bloodline]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Mon Cala]] in the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] rule. In line for the throne of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], Kolina ascended to be the<ref name="CWA: Iceberg Three" /> [[King of Mon Cala/Legends|King of Mon Cala]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], becoming the eighty-second ruler to bear the title.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Mon Cala">{{SWE|locations|moncala|Mon Cala}}</ref> As the leader of the Mon Calamari, Kolina kept his world allied to the Republic in its war against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="CWA: Iceberg Three" /> with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Meena Tills/Legends|Meena Tills]] representing their people in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="Encyclopedia: Tills">{{SWE|characters|meenatills|Meena Tills}}</ref> Being the Supreme [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of [[Mon Cala's military/Legends|Mon Cala's military]],<ref name="Water War" /> Kolina was directly served by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] of the [[Mon Calamari Guard/Legends|Mon Calamari Guard]], who acted as the chief military [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] to the crown.<ref name="Explore: Water War" /> Working with a democratically-elected government,<ref name="Encyclopedia: Tills" /> the [[Mon Calamari Council]],<ref name="CW5">{{CW|5}}</ref> which balanced out the power of the royal house,<ref name="Encyclopedia: Tills" /> Kolina lived in the [[Mon Calamari Royal Palace/Legends|royal palace]]<ref name="Water War" /> in [[Coral City/Legends|Mon Calamari City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of Mon Cala.<ref name="Warriors of the Deep">''[[The Clone Wars: Warriors of the Deep]]''</ref> He eventually had a son, [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]], who became the [[Prince/Legends|prince]] and was to one [[Standard day/Legends|day]] succeed him as the [[King/Legends|King]] of Mon Cala.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Lee-Char">{{SWE|characters|princeleechar|Prince Lee-Char}}</ref>

[[File:Yos_Kolina.png|thumb|left|150px|Kolina speaks with Plo Koon and Anakin Skywalker.]]
As with his predecessors, Kolina was faced with the challenge of unifying two of Mon Cala's [[Species/Legends|species]]:<ref name="Encyclopedia: Mon Cala" /> the peaceful Mon Calamari and the aggressive,<ref name="Water War" /> isolationist [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]], who long resented the former's advances in technology, the arts, and [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Politics/Legends|affairs]].<ref name="Encyclopedia: Quarren">{{SWE|groups|quarren|Quarren}}</ref> Despite their striking differences, Kolina formed a friendship with the [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] of the Quarren, [[Nossor Ri/Legends|Nossor Ri]], a bond that allowed the two leaders to keep the peace on their homeworld through open discussion and mutual respect.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Ri">{{SWE|characters|nossorri|Nossor Ri}}</ref> Working closely with Ri,<ref name="Warriors of the Deep" /> Kolina became indispensable to the civilian harmony amidst the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of Mon Cala.<ref name="CWA: Iceberg Three" /> Under his rule the Mon Calamari and the Quarren long remained united in their support of the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Kolina even led Mon Calamari and Quarren [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] into a number of battles, displaying bravery and loyalty to his people.<ref name="Warriors of the Deep" />

During the Clone Wars, the Mon Calamari contributed to the Republic's war effort by providing Republic [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] with a special metal [[Ore/Legends|ore]] to strengthen [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating.<ref name="CWA: Iceberg Three" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the second [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the war,<ref name="FF-2014 7" /> the Confederacy, looking to bring the [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Calamari system]] onto their side, began to make advances on the [[Star system/Legends|system]] with an invasion [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Kolina was soon contacted by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who sought to learn more about the situation. Kolina reported the imposing threat of the Separatists and stated that without the Republic's help, he would be unable to guarantee the stability of Mon Cala or their region of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], before ending the [[Hologram/Legends|holotransmission]] to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="CWA: Iceberg Three" />

In response to Kolina's statements, Koon brought a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] task force of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[104th Battalion/Legends|104th Battalion]] to the Calamari system, reinforcing a [[Iceberg Three Republic outpost|Republic outpost]] on the [[Comet/Legends|comet]] [[Iceberg Three]] against Grievous's invasion fleet. However, Koon and his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] were unable to prevent Grievous from continuing to advance on the system. Kolina thus faced the rising potential of civil war on his world,<ref name="CWA: Iceberg Three" /> with the Quarren&mdash;many of whom had grown dissatisfied with the Mon Calamari monarchy as well as the Republic&mdash;looking to ally themselves with the Confederacy, in a bid to seize Mon Cala for themselves. The Confederacy capitalized on this rift by targeting Kolina himself.<ref name="Water War" />

===Death and legacy===
{{Quote|If it comes down to it, we must be willing to fight&mdash;or even die for what we believe in. That is what King Kolina would have done and what I'm sure Prince Lee-Char will do as well.|Gial Ackbar|<ref name="Warriors of the Deep" />}}
As part of the Confederacy's plan to secure the Calamari system, Commander [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]] was sent to Mon Cala to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Kolina, as doing so would compromise the unity between the Mon Calamari and the Quarren and escalate the world toward civil war.<ref name="Prisoners">{{TCW|Prisoners}}</ref> Tamson confronted Kolina in the palace's throne room and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the King of Mon Cala with a [[Staff/Legends|staff]], leaving his corpse to be found by his people. In the wake of Kolina's death,<ref name="Water War" /> a dispute erupted with the Quarren over their sovereignty and the line of succession of the monarchy.<ref name="Insider 129: Blood-Feud">{{InsiderCite|129|Blood-Feud: Warriors of the Deep!}}</ref> Seeing an opportunity to break free of rule by the Mon Calamari crown, the Quarren challenged the monarchy, hoping to place one of their own on the throne. With a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] crisis unfolding, Captain Ackbar requested the presence of Republic officials to help mediate the situation.<ref name="Water War" /> Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] General Anakin Skywalker were sent to Mon Cala,<ref name="CWA: Iceberg Three" /> but Nossor Ri responded by asking for a Separatist [[Envoy/Legends|envoy]], who came in the form of Riff Tamson. At a gathering between the Mon Calamari and the Quarren, Ri refused to support the coronation of the young and inexperienced Prince Lee-Char.<ref name="Water War" /> Tamson exploited the Quarren&ndash;Mon Calamari tensions in Kolina's absence, convincing Ri to side with the Separatists so that the Quarren could claim control over Mon Cala.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Ri" /> In secret, Tamson had made arrangements with Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to be the true ruler of Mon Cala, instead of Ri and the Quarren.<ref name="Prisoners" />

[[File:YosKolinasdeadbody-WW.png|thumb|right|220px|Yos Kolina, assassinated by Riff Tamson, is found in his throne room.]]
In the ensuing [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|Battle of Mon Cala]], Tamson and Ri led a combined assault on Mon Calamari [[City/Legends|City]]. The Mon Calamari and their reinforcements from the Republic Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]] continually lost ground,<ref name="Water War" /> with all of them eventually being captured by Tamson and put to work in [[Prison/Legends|prison]] camps for Dooku and the Confederacy.<ref name="Gungan Attack">{{TCW|Gungan Attack}}</ref> Tamson then took Kolina's throne for himself, much to the shock of Ri and the Quarren, who began to regret their alliance with the Confederacy. When Lee-Char and his Jedi protector, [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], were the only ones who had evaded capture, Dooku sought to finish what he had begun with Kolina's assassination: the termination of the royal bloodline through the execution of the prince.<ref name="Prisoners" /> Despite grappling with the challenge of living up to Kolina,<ref name="Warriors of the Deep" /> Lee-Char overcame his doubts and grew to become Mon Cala's next ruler, using his [[Parent/Legends|father's]] old friendship with Ri to convince the Quarren to re-side with the Mon Calamari and the Republic. Tamson and the Separatist presence on Mon Cala were thus vanquished by the allied forces, and Lee-Char succeeded his father as<ref name="Prisoners" /> the eighty-third King of Mon Cala.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Lee-Char" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Your father was my trusted friend. I am&hellip; sorry for your loss.|Nossor Ri, to Lee-Char|<ref name="Water War" />}}
A Mon Calamari male, Yos Kolina had [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and orange skin.<ref name="Water War" /> As the King of Mon Cala, he kept his people, the Mon Calamari, allied to the Republic and the Jedi Order in the midst of galactic conflict. He displayed honesty even when it made him regret doing so, telling Plo Koon and Anakin Skywalker that he would be unable to keep the peace in the Calamari system without their help.<ref name="CWA: Iceberg Three" /> A strong and confident leader,<ref name="Warriors of the Deep" /> Kolina dedicated himself to serving all inhabitants of Mon Cala, including his Quarren neighbors, in spite of their differences. He formed a friendship with Chieftain Nossor Ri,<ref name="Encyclopedia: Ri" /> becoming his trusted friend and ally,<ref name="Water War" /> and worked hard<ref name="Ackbar's Underwater Army">''[[The Clone Wars: Ackbar's Underwater Army]]''</ref> to keep disputes civil and respectful<ref name="Encyclopedia: Mon Cala" /> through public dialogue.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Ri" /> He became vital to the peace on Mon Cala, and his assassination thus caused cooperation to deteriorate and tensions to escalate.<ref name="CWA: Iceberg Three" /> As a military commander, he led Mon Calamari and Quarren soldiers into many battles. He was revered for his bravery, to the point that tales were told of his valor as king.<ref name="Warriors of the Deep" /> A widely respected ruler,<ref name="Ackbar's Underwater Army" /> he became an example and role model for his son, Prince Lee-Char,<ref name="Prisoners" /> who constantly sought to become a leader like him,<ref name="Warriors of the Deep" /> particularly when tasked with unifying Mon Cala. By the time of Lee-Char's coronation,<ref name="Prisoners" /> both Captain Gial Ackbar<ref name="Water War" /> and Senator Meena Tills believed that Kolina would be proud of his son.<ref name="Prisoners" /> As the monarch, Kolina wore traditional [[Clothing/Legends|robes]] and the [[shell crown]] of his people.<ref name="Water War" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|With the Calamari system producing vital metal ore resources used to strengthen armor plating, it's up to players to protect the Mon Calamari leader and prevent Separatists from taking control.|StarWars.com first references the character of Yos Kolina|<ref name="New CWA Campaign" />}}
[[File:LeeCharCrowned-Prisoners.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kolina is succeeded by Lee-Char as King of Mon Cala in "Prisoners."]]
King Yos Kolina was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series and was introduced in "Mission on Iceberg Three,"<ref name="CWA: Iceberg Three" /> a mini-game campaign for the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'' video game]] that was released in [[July]] [[2011]]. The story for the game was developed with input from Series Supervising Director [[Dave Filoni]] as a lead-in<ref name="New CWA Campaign">{{SWArchive|url=games/clonewars_adventures_iceberg3/index.html|text=New ''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'' Summer Series - ''Mission on Iceberg Three''}}</ref> to the "Battle of Mon Cala" story arc, which was featured as the [[September]] 2011 premiere of the television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]].<ref name="Explore: Water War" /> In "Mission on Iceberg Three," Kolina appeared in [[holograph]]ic form in the opening cutscene of the mission;<ref name="CWA: Iceberg Three" /> his voice actor was not credited.<ref name="CWA Credits">{{WebCite|url=http://www.clonewarsadventures.com/credits.html|text=Clone Wars Adventures: Game Credits|work=clonewarsadventures.com|archivedate=20110724192208}}</ref> His assassination was referenced in the final cutscene by Plo Koon,<ref name="CWA: Iceberg Three" /> though it was not until the episode "[[Prisoners]]" that his murderer was confirmed to be Riff Tamson.<ref name="Prisoners" />

Kolina was named for [[Jose Molina]], the writer for the "Battle of Mon Cala" story arc.<ref name="Mon Cala Commentary">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Four|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Four]], "Battle of Mon Cala" Commentary</ref> The character was the first member of the Mon Calamari monarchy to be introduced into ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]].<ref name="Insider 129: Blood-Feud" /> His name was misspelled as "'''Yolina'''" in the "Prisoners" [http://www.starwars.com/explore/the-clone-wars/ep403/#!/about episode guide]<ref name="Explore: Prisoners">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep403|text="Prisoners" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> and as "'''Yos Kalina'''" in the Mon Calamari [http://www.starwars.com/explore/encyclopedia/locations/moncala entry] in the [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|Encyclopedia]] on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Encyclopedia: Mon Calamari">{{SWE|groups|moncalamari|Mon Calamari}}</ref>
